title: Color Tuning
description: Opt-in pngquant pass for the resourcepack minify pipeline. Only pngs whose cache key matches at least one entry in `include` get quantized; everything else is left as-is. All quantized files use the same `defaults` settings — there is no per-rule override.

defaults.description: Settings applied to every png that gets quantized (used uniformly across all included files).

include.description: Glob patterns matched against the cache key (includes the `resourcepack/` prefix). A png is quantized iff it matches at least one pattern here. Each entry is a bare glob string, not an object.

items.description: Glob pattern evaluated against the cache key.

maxColors.description: Maximum palette size. 256 = full palette; lower for icons / limited palettes.

skipIfLarger.description: Only write output when smaller than input (`--skip-if-larger`).

force.description: Overwrite existing output files in place (`--force`).
